lines.text: Many learners say: It is depend on you.
Depends! It depends on the weather.

native.tip: 中文习惯先说“是”，所以容易说 It is depend。depend 本身就是动词，不加 is，要说 It depends。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “It is depend on you.”😅 depend 本身就是动词，前面不加 is：“It depends on you.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“It depends on you.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Depend is already a verb, so it needs no is.
en.caption: Do you say “It is depend on you.” 😅 Depend is already a verb, so it needs no is: “It depends on you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
